name: Sweeeeet ♪ Chocolate
source:
I was new to the country. No friends or bearings.
A place where I knew no one's name.

I met a very young girl.

Her name was "Chocolate." She called me "Oniichan."

She was truly a tiny girl. She worked in a restaurant.

But this restaurant had another side...

"I can't have sex yet but... will you buy me?"

It seemed she had been abducted. The
owner of this place was a sex slave trader.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081999.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
初来乍到这个国度的我举目无亲、人生地不熟。
在这座连一个熟人名字都叫不出来的陌生之地，

我邂逅了一名年幼的小女孩。

她的名字叫“巧可拉”，甜甜地唤我“哥哥”。

娇小玲珑的她在一间餐厅里打工。

然而这间餐厅背地里却有着另一副面孔……

“虽然我现在还不能做爱……但你愿意买下我吗？”

原来她是被拐卖到这里的，
而这间店的老板，正是一名性奴隶人贩子。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081999.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
